newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia C.Bank makes no trade on T-bill mkt for MoF.
newsitem.headline: Russia C.Bank makes no trade on T-bill mkt for MoF.

text.p: The central bank did not intervene on the government securities market on behalf of the Finance Ministry on Friday, the bank's open-market operations department said.

Apart from intervening on its own account for liquidity-smoothing and monetary policy purposes, the central bank buys and sells securities as part of its management of the Finance Ministry's debt and asset portfolio.
